title: Implement first service recovery workflow
purpose: Drive the MVP through a realistic operator flow such as nginx 502 diagnosis and controlled restart.
scope: Implement read-only diagnostics: service logs, status, port/http check, config test.
Generate a plan that separates automatic diagnostics from restart approval.
Run restart or simulated restart through execute-with-confirmation policy.
Show operator summary: what was checked, what changed, and final health result.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only diagnostics run without approval and without persistent side effects.
Restart pauses for confirmation in production-sensitive mode.
All tool calls and results appear in audit timeline.
Operator sees a final explanation grounded in observed events.
verification: Run denied restart path and confirm no restart effect.
risk_notes: The workflow must not infer success from model output; it must verify actual service health.
